# Noust

> Noust deploys web applications on Linux servers: Nginx or Apache, TLS, systemd, databases and backups, every deploy a health-gated release with instant rollback, and an optional browser console over a JSON API.

Noust (previously WASM) is a Python 3.10+ command line, run as root on the server it manages, with a browser console and a JSON API at /api (OpenAPI at /api/openapi.json). Other servers, scripts and MCP clients use the API with a bearer token: the command line can drive a server remotely (noust --context NAME ...), and POST /api/mcp speaks the Model Context Protocol. Variables' values and secrets are never given to a client.

## Documentation

- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/api.md): The JSON API: authentication, tokens, errors, versions, jobs, events and every area
- [The MCP endpoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/mcp.md): The MCP endpoint: tools, prompts, resources, guardrails and how to connect a client
- [Operating a server from elsewhere](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/remote.md): Operating a server from elsewhere: contexts, tokens that never go in an argument, exit codes
- [A server written down: the manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/manifest.md): A server written down: validate, plan, apply and export a manifest
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/security.md): The security model: roles, tokens, sudo mode, four eyes, audit, what is not defended
- [Teams, projects and environments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/teams.md): Teams, projects and environments; roles on a project; tokens bound to a team
- [Single sign-on, directories and provisioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/sso.md): Single sign-on with OpenID Connect and turning the password sign-in off
- [The console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/console.md): The browser console, screen by screen
- [Configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/CONFIG.md): Every configuration setting, its default and what it does
- [Releases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/releases.md): Releases, the health gate and rollback
- [Docker Compose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/compose.md): Docker Compose applications, hooks, the relay and adopting a stack
- [Container applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/containers.md): Container applications: a Dockerfile, a registry image or Railpack
- [Build, start and runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/build.md): How an application is built: commands, runtimes, the sandbox
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/recipes.md): The catalogue of applications that install with one command
- [Databases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/databases.md): Databases: engines, instances, access, backups and imports
- [Domains](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/domains.md): Domains, certificates and DNS
- [Backups and disaster recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/disaster-recovery.md): Backing up Noust itself and restoring a server
- [Terminal and one-off commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/terminal.md): The terminal and one-off commands in the browser
- [The Noust central](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/CENTRAL.md): Running a central that manages several servers
- [Resource monitor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/MONITOR.md): The monitor, observations and notifications
- [Probes and the status page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/probes.md): Probes of an address from outside the application, and a public status page
- [Searching the logs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/logs.md): Searching the logs of every application and server, and how long they are kept
- [Noust y el Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (categoría MEDIA)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/ENS.md): The ENS category MEDIUM profile and its evidence
- [Compliance: controls and the frameworks that switch them on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/COMPLIANCE.md): Compliance controls and the frameworks that switch them on, with the clause each serves
- [Platforms and the installer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Perkybeet/noust/main/docs/PLATFORMS.md): Supported operating systems, processors and the installer
